abstract: AIM: To investigate the role of accessory cells (and other chronic inflammatory cells) in the host immune response to testicular seminoma by defining their immunophenotypic characteristics and topographical arrangement. METHODS AND RESULTS: A panel of antibodies applicable to paraffin-embedded tissues was employed to characterize the host chronic inflammatory response in eight cases of classical testicular seminoma. The antibodies were directed against CD45RO, CD20, CD68, acid cysteine proteinase inhibitor (ACPI), MAC387, muramidase (MUR), S100 protein, Factor XIIIa, CD21 and HLA Class II. In all cases the majority of the inflammatory cells were T-lymphocytes situated mainly in areas of apparent tumour destruction. Large numbers of macrophages/dendritic cells which had not been evident by conventional light microscopy were also demonstrated. In particular, an immunophenotypically distinct population of accessory cells showing a specific pattern of distribution was revealed. It clearly rimmed islands of tumour and showed strong positive staining for CD68, MAC387 and HLA Class II. CONCLUSION: The study has identified an immunophenotypically distinct population of accessory cells showing a characteristic topographical arrangement. It is proposed that it represents a subpopulation of macrophages which are responding directly to the tumour and are likely to play a part in influencing tumour dynamics.
abstract_ja:
目的：精巣セミノーマにおける宿主の免疫応答の役割を明らかにするため、付随細胞（およびその他の慢性炎症細胞）の免疫表現型と分布を検討すること。
方法と結果：パラフィン包埋組織に適用可能な抗体パネル（CD45RO、CD20、CD68、酸性システインプロテアーゼ阻害因子（ACPI）、MAC387、ムラミダーゼ（MUR）、S100蛋白、第XIIIa因子、CD21、HLAクラスII）を用い、古典型精巣セミノーマ8例の慢性炎症反応を解析した。全例で炎症細胞の大部分はTリンパ球であり、主に腫瘍の破壊が認められる部位に存在していた。従来の光学顕微鏡では認識されなかった多数のマクロファージ／樹状細胞も明らかになった。特に、腫瘍胞巣を縁取るように分布する免疫表現型の異なる付随細胞集団が認められ、CD68、MAC387、HLAクラスIIに強陽性であった。
結論：特徴的な位置関係を示す、免疫表現型の異なる付随細胞集団を同定した。これらは腫瘍に直接応答するマクロファージのサブ集団であり、腫瘍動態に影響を及ぼしている可能性がある。
